title: Five Lessons That Finally Explain Why, Not Just How | vitalii.no
description:
Artem's diabetes game already had map levels for day-simulation and quizzes, but there was no structured way to actually teach the underlying ideas — how food raises sugar, what insulin does, why type 2 is different, what happens with too little insulin, or what to do for a low. A child could play for hours without ever walking through the reasoning step by step.

app/js/lessons.js adds a new 295-line lesson engine driving five lessons on the shared game stage. Each lesson is a short script of four steps — a caption, the only buttons allowed, an optional multiple-choice question, and a 'done' condition — followed by a final round: either a quiz card scored with stars, or, for one lesson, a 'be the factory' round where the player manually fills the insulin role for 30 seconds. play-sim.js gained new simulated variables to support this, including insulin resistance, how hard a tired factory can still work, and exercise that lets muscles absorb sugar without insulin.

Artem's game now has five guided lessons instead of open-ended simulation only, each ending in a quiz or an interactive round scored with stars. All five are reachable on the level map and covered by an end-to-end Playwright test that plays each one to completion.
